deadline.value: No fetchable page gives an application deadline for the PhD.

gre_subject.value: No fetchable official page mentions a Physics GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Under the university-wide PhD rule, applicants must first find a supervisor and a department before a formal application.
supervisor.quote: you will first need to find a supervisor and a department and then make a formal application

funding.value: All PhD students can apply for the University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship, which is assessed competitively each quarter after an invitation to apply.
funding.quote: All PhD students are able to apply for a Doctoral Scholarship when they have submitted an application to the PhD programme | Applications are assessed on a quarterly basis, usually around March, June, September and November of each year. | Most successful international scholarship applicants will have the most relevant grades

entry_route.value: No fetchable official page says whether applicants enter directly from a bachelor's or need a master's.

notes: The physics PhD page (https://www.otago.ac.nz/physics/postgraduate/postgraduate-degrees/phd) is titled 'PhD, Department of Physics' in an otago.ac.nz search result but returns a Cloudflare 403 to the fetcher, so the department's own deadline, GRE, English and entry rules are unverified. Supervisor and funding come from university-wide AskOtago pages, not from the physics page. The scholarship assessment rounds are 'usually around March, June, September and November' with no year or date, so no deadline or time_sensitive date is set. The doctoral scholarship page is blocked: https://www.otago.ac.nz/courses/scholarships/university-of-otago-doctoral-scholarship.
